title: Tech Note: Targeted Verification of Data
author: Tim Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: VERIFY DATA FILE / VERIFY CURRENT DATA FILE commands
SELECTION TO ARRAY error-triggered table scanning

historical_commentary.text: Programmatic, targeted data-file verification via VERIFY CURRENT DATA FILE with a callback is still a current and fully valid 4D technique for building custom health-check tooling, since 4D has not replaced this command or the MSC/Admin Window verification UI; the component patterns shown (table-subset checks, JSON-based error logs) remain directly applicable today.
related_updates: VERIFY DATA FILE / VERIFY CURRENT DATA FILE and the MSC Verify tab remain the standard data integrity tools in current 4D versions, unchanged in core approach

Modern 4D code would likely use ORDA-oriented object/collection handling (as already shown here) rather than any older array-heavy techniques, but the core commands and callback pattern are still current
